data.title: Transport ministry speeds up high-speed rail work
data.description: The Ministry of Transport is accelerating construction of the first phase of the Thai-Chinese high-speed rail project while preparing to launch bidding for the second phase, which will extend the line to Nong Khai and strengthen onnectivity with Laos and China to support regional trade, investment and economic growth.

data.title: Rain dampens major fire in France
data.description: LEGE-CAP-FERRET, France - Firefighters in France on Thursday were hopeful a massive forest fire was no longer spreading, as Spain said there were “almost no flames” left after a similar blaze near Madrid.

data.title: How does Hong Kong’s new end-of-life law affect patients and medical staff?
data.description: A new law allowing patients in Hong Kong to reject life-sustaining treatments when they are terminally ill will take effect on Friday.

data.title: Health starts on a Thai plate
data.description: Thai cuisine has long been celebrated for its bold flavours, but beyond a balance of sweet, sour, salty and spicy lies another defining characteristic: many of Thailand’s traditional recipes were created with wellness in mind.

data.title: Bangkok Komatsu Sales Unveils New 20-Ton Hydraulic Excavators
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – Bangkok Komatsu Sales Co., Ltd. (BKS), the sole authorised distributor of Komatsu construction machinery in Thailand for more than 70 years under Siam Motors Group, recently officially launched the all-new Komatsu PC200-11M2 and Komatsu PC210-11M2 20-ton hydraulic excavators. The new generation machines are designed to meet the evolving demands of today's construction industry, delivering outstanding performance, durability, cost efficiency, and renowned Japanese quality while reaffirming the company's long-standing commitment to providing innovative solutions and exceptional customer support across Thailand.

data.title: Chiang Mai-Chiang Rai highway partially flooded but passable
data.description: Motorists on the main highway between Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai were being advised on Thursday to drive carefully as workers are draining floodwater from the surface in some locations.

data.title: Search continues for Russian siblings missing from Pattaya
data.description: The search continued on Thursday for two Russian siblings who have been missing from their house in Pattaya for five days, with police bringing in two sniffer dogs to assist in the mission.

data.title: Thailand awaits Georgian investigation of blogger’s death
data.description: Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow on Thursday expressed sadness on the passing of Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo in Georgia, saying the cause of death has yet to be concluded and is still under investigation.

data.title: Nolan's 'Odyssey' boosts sales of mythology tales in UK
data.description: LONDON - Christopher Nolan's adaptation of The Odyssey has not only lured legions of fans to cinemas, but sparked huge interest in the United Kingdom in Homer's epic poem and other Greek and Roman mythology works.

data.title: CMA launches “The NEXT Chapter” with 5 Engines to accelerate cement industry toward Net Zero 2050
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has advanced its strategy, “The NEXT Chapter to Net Zero 2050,” through five key implementation pillars - “5 Engines to Net Zero” - under the theme ‘Accelerating Collaborative Action towards Net Zero 2050.’ The initiative aims to accelerate the transition of Thailand’s cement industry toward a low-carbon future, while elevating its role as a Climate Solution Partner, in alignment with the Thailand 2050 Net Zero Cement and Concrete Roadmap, a shared industry commitment.

data.title: Thailand to host WHO traditional medicine summit in 2027
data.description: WHO has selected Thailand to host its third global traditional medicine summit, bringing health ministers, policymakers and researchers together in 2027

data.title: Malaysia says Myanmar agrees to take 5,000 Rohingya refugees
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim says Myanmar has agreed to take 5,000 Rohingya asylum seekers currently in Malaysia, where tension between the refugees and local communities is on the rise.

data.title: BTS pulls out of Grammys amid ‘Asian pop’ dispute
data.description: SEOUL - The global K-pop superstars BTS say they will not submit their music for next year’s Grammy Awards, after the Recording Academy introduced a new Asian pop category that has been criticised for limiting the success of regional artists.

data.title: Japan develops heat-beating cooling booths
data.description: As extreme summer temperatures become an increasingly serious public health concern, Japanese manufacturers have introduced a portable cooling booth designed to help people recover quickly from dangerous heat exposure.

data.title: Drones and blackouts inflict tense summer on Crimea
data.description: SEVASTOPOL - A boom rang out over the city of Sevastopol on the Russian-annexed peninsula of Crimea.

data.title: Suicide attempts on Phuket bridges on successive days
data.description: PHUKET - Two women driving black Mercedes-Benz sedans have attempted suicide from bridges above the sea in Phuket on successive days. One was saved, the other has not been found.

data.title: South Korean web sleuths fight AI deepfake porn
data.description: SEOUL - Under banners emblazoned “Solidarity” and “We stand together with victims”, a group of South Korean women digital detectives dredges the internet for a scourge of illegal AI-enabled pornography.

data.title: Central Pattana Leverages Insights for 'Mom Moments' Mother's Day Campaign
data.description: In remembrance of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, The Queen Mother’s boundless compassioninspired by her royalquote“Ilove being a mother the most”,the love and bond between mothers and children will be conveyed through nationwide experiences.

data.title: Meet the astronomer digging for Milky Way ‘fossils’
data.description: GRONINGEN, Netherlands - Amina Helmi’s passion for the Milky Way is clear as soon as one steps into her small office at the University of Groningen, in the north of the Netherlands.

data.title: EC defends backing 2 controversial candidates
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) has published its rulings explaining why two senators from Amnat Charoen were deemed qualified to contest the 2024 Senate election, following renewed calls by iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont.

data.title: Australia sets Commonwealth record for swimming golds
data.description: GLASGOW - Australia rounded off their best-ever Commonwealth Games in the pool with nine more swimming gold medals on Wednesday for a total of 37, while Kate O'Connor cruised to heptathlon gold for Northern Ireland.

data.title: Refreshed Jeeno ready for big test at Lytham
data.description: Thai world No.2 Jeeno Thitikul is ready for her next challenge at the Women's British Open at Royal Lytham & St Annes in England after taking a break to recharge.

data.title: Democrat MP urges public against TH-AI Passport
data.description: Democrat MP Karndee Leopairote has called on the public to oppose the government's 1.621-billion-baht TH-AI Passport project, demanding greater transparency and value for taxpayers.

data.title: Airport Rail Link power outage fixed
data.description: An electrical problem that disrupted Airport Rail Link services on Thursday morning has been resolved, with trains returning to their normal schedules at 9.30am, the operator said .

data.title: Group exhibition explores Thailand's changing contemporary art scene
data.description: Art lovers are invited to comprehend the changing directions of Thai contemporary art during "Transverse: Navigating Emerging Thai Art", which is running at Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok's Art Space by Moca Bangkok, until Sept 27.

data.title: 'One World', two artists at Gallery VER
data.description: Gallery VER presents "Unus Mundus", which draws inspiration from expressions of belief and faith embedded in Eastern traditions, societies and cultures, from Saturday to Sept 26.

data.title: OPDC eyes some branch office closures
data.description: The Office of the Public Sector Development Commission (OPDC) will propose closing provincial branch offices of state agencies as part of an overhaul of the public administration system.

data.title: Up to 23 feared dead in Japan quake
data.description: KUMAMOTO, Japan - Up to 23 people were feared dead on Thursday after a major earthquake in Japan, with four bodies now pulled out from the tangled wreckage of a shopping mall ripped apart by a suspected massive gas explosion.

data.title: US actor Jared Leto denies latest accusations of sexual assault
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - US actor and singer Jared Leto on Wednesday denied allegations of sexual assault and harassment leveled against him by ten women in a new documentary aired by the BBC.
